import json,re,os,time,urllib.request
t=open("/root/Iryna_Karmazina/.env").read()
env=dict(re.findall(r"^(\w+)=(.*)$",t,re.M))
K=env.get("N8N_API_KEY","").strip().strip(chr(34)).strip(chr(39))
B="https://irynakarmazina.app.n8n.cloud/api/v1/"
BK="/root/n8n-backup-"+time.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")

def req(u,method="GET",data=None):
    r=urllib.request.Request(u,method=method,headers={"X-N8N-API-KEY":K,"Content-Type":"application/json"},data=json.dumps(data).encode() if data else None)
    return json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=30).read())

ws=req(B+"workflows?limit=100").get("data",[])
